name: Banh dau xanh
summary: Bánh đậu xanh is a mung-bean cake of Tây Hải Phòng, honored with bánh cuốn and chả rươi.
origin: Tây Hải Phòng, on the Hồng Bàng ward account of 1 September 2025.
culture: The city portal on 29 September 2023 names bánh đa cua and chả chìa Hạ Lũng for a different list. Both honor sentences stay.
where: Tây Hải Phòng, as that ward account writes it. A street was not printed. Check on arrival.
